name: qa-designer-agent
conclusion: qa-designer-agent (Escalate) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 1 clarification rule, 4 approval gates; none for validation rules, escalation rules. Strongest: approval gates.

autonomy_limits.conclusion: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: storing credentials or personal data in output files.

statements.quote: Never store credentials or personal data in any output file

clarification_rules.conclusion: 1 clarification rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: confidence below 95% before estimating coverage.

statements.quote: **Confidence gate:** If below 95%, ask targeted clarification questions grouped by category and stop.

approval_gates.conclusion: 4 approval gates (4 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list: confirming coverage estimates before generating cases; impact summary before updating designs.

statements.quote: | `coverage-estimation` | After technique-selection | Coverage summary — stop for confirmation |
Stop for user confirmation before generating cases.
Show impact summary and updated test count. Stop for confirmation.
